subQuests.subQuestName: Take a walk by the water's edge

742280101.text: Hey there, Melusine friend! Need any help?

742280102.text: #Oh! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's you! Long time no see!

742280105.text: Hehe, right in one! You know me too well.

742280106.text: Everyone in Merusea is preparing a surprise gift for Monsieur Neuvillette. We're working together to make him a new outfit! I was about to go find some gems and shells to decorate it with!

742280109.text: Uh, is it really okay for you to tell us like that, though?

742280111.text: Sorry, it's my first time doing something like this, so it just slipped out...

742280112.text: I'm not sure why, but seeing everyone working towards the same goal like this, my heart just won't stop racing...

742280113.text: Paimon totally gets it! The mood's just so infectious that you get swept up in the hype and you just can't stop, won't stop, right?

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to get underwater
Collect the shiniest and brightest Beryl Conches

742280301.text: Tidalga left by the roadside. It's soaking wet, as though it had just been taken out of the water.

742281101.text: Monsieur Neuvillette! Can I ask a question?

742281103.text: I've heard that Liyue has fire wrapped in paper, lights that can grant any wish! Is that true?

742281104.text: Fire wrapped in paper? Wouldn't it break? And isn't that dangerous?

742281105.text: Yeah, that's right! If your wish is to burn the whole house down, then it might come true.

742281106.text: Whoooa, Puca! Where'd you learn to joke like that?

742281108.text: Well... There is something like that. They're called "Xiao Lanterns."

742281109.text: They aren't dangerous if properly handled, but they do not actually have the power to grant wishes... I'm sorry.

742281110.text: Awww, you don't need to apologize!

742281111.text: Heh... Simply listening to me describe them would be quite dull. How about I bring some back for you once I visit Liyue?

742281112.text: That'd be amazing! And it'd be even better if you can take some more pictures this time!

742280402.text: *whimper*... I never imagined I'd dig up an Armored Crab digging for gems...

742280404.text: It's fine, fine, I'm not hurt... Sorry for making you worry...

742280405.text: Good thing this vishap showed up! Gobbled that nasty crab right up!

742280408.text: Maybe they don't actually like crab that much, it doesn't look too thrilled...

742280410.text: Oh right! We should be focusing on... why is there a vishap here?

742280411.text: No clue! Never seen one around these parts before.

742280412.text: Monsieur Neuvillette warned us that while some vishaps are super friendly, others can be really dangerous, so we shouldn't get too close.

742280413.text: Whew... Seems I'm pretty lucky, running into such a cute vishap like this!

742280415.text: Then be sure to give it a proper thank you the next time you run into it, okay?

742280416.text: Yeah, for sure! And I'll treat it to something tasty too! Only thing is that I'm not sure what it likes... Definitely not giant crabs, though!

742280418.text: Tidalga? Wouldn't have thought such a big vishap would like something...

742280419.text: Whoa! Tidalga! When did that get there!?

742280420.text: Huh? So this pile of Tidalga isn't yours?

742280421.text: Nope! Haven't even had a chance to dive in yet... Did some kind soul overhear us and leave it here?

742280423.text: Looks like I really am super lucky today! Can't believe that fashion magazine horoscope was actually accurate...

742280424.text: Then may the stars watch over us, that our gift may arrive safe and sound!

742280426.text: Oh yeah, here! These are the Beryl Conches we gathered. Are these enough?

742280427.text: Plenty! Whoooa, so sparkly, I can barely open my eyes...

742280429.text: Hehe, that's just how I like to express how grateful I am!

742280433.text: Well then, with my gems, your Beryl Conches, and the nice fairy's Tidalga, my mission here is complete!

742280434.text: If everything goes this well, the clothes should be ready in a couple days!

742280435.text: Hey, when we deliver the clothes to the Palais Mermonia, will you two come see what we made?

742280437.text: Hehe, let's meet up at the Palais Mermonia then! A whole bunch of us Melusines will be there!

742280438.text: Sounds great! We'll be looking forward to hearing from you!

742280431.text: Really? Then I'm buying a pair too, should help with gem-hunting...

742280432.text: #Don't buy {M#his}{F#her} nonsense! Not a word of it's true!

742280501.text: Wow, it's been a long time since Paimon's seen the Palais Mermonia this busy! Puca wasn't kidding, there are a ton of Melusines...

742280502.text: Huh? Something's off, though. Everyone feels kinda... tense?

742280504.text: Mr. Gestionnaire! Do you enjoy your work here in the Palais Mermonia?

742280505.text: Uh, are you... are you asking me?

742280506.text: Err, well, about that, I can't really say I'm happy, or particularly unhappy... Though I've been here for some time now, I still feel as though I only just started...

742280507.text: Got it, so put another way... Work at the Palais Mermonia is so exciting that it feels as though you're always filled with energy — like you're in your prime, correct?

742280508.text: Exciting? Oh, no, no! More anxious, really...

742280509.text: An exciting anxiety? Is being a Gestionnaire really that nerve-wracking? And here I thought only the Marechaussee Phantom was like that.

742280510.text: Oh, no, no! It musn't be exciting. If anything on the job excites your nerves, that means the process has already gone terribly wrong...

742280511.text: Is that so? Sedile never mentioned anything like that.

742280512.text: Sedile... Ah, you mean Officer Sedile of the Marechaussee Phantom? Wait, are you her colleague?

742280513.text: Of course not! If we're talking ability, I definitely would've passed the exam first!

742280514.text: Granna, now's not the time to get competitive! Look at the poor man, he's so nervous he's sweating bullets.

742280515.text: Really? I thought that if someone looks really nervous during an interview, that means you're asking the right questions.

742280516.text: Ahem! Excuse me, Mr. Gestionnaire, are there any troubles in your work life that you find difficult to discuss?

742280517.text: Pardon me, but, interview? Am I being interviewed right now?

742280519.text: Oh, no. Oh no no no no...

742280520.text: According to regulations, Gestionnaires are strictly forbidden from giving private interviews, especially to parties of unknown provenance...

742280521.text: Excuse me, Miss Melusine, but might I inquire your full name and the newspaper at which you are currently employed?

742280522.text: Uh... Special Reporter Laume, for the "Buoyant Otter Gazette"!

742280523.text: (You obviously just made that up...! Laume, what happened to truth in reporting!?)

742280524.text: Hmm... Does the Court of Fontaine really have a paper like that? I'll... I need to go check the files...

742280525.text: My good sir, are you feeling alright? You certainly look as though your nerves have been excited right now...

742280526.text: ...Right, the process! Sorry, good ladies, could you please wait here for a moment? I need to go find a colleague from the publishing office...

742280527.text: (Oh, for... We were just going to ask him how to get to Monsieur Neuvillette's office... Yet somehow, it turned into a practice interview for Laume...)

742280529.text: The tea Miss Cornelia so kindly made for us is nearly cold, just what have you... Oh my word! What happened here? Why are there so many Melusines?

742280530.text: Ah! Mr. Roialte, please, give me a hand. I can't possibly take care of all these Melusines myself, much less give an interview while I'm at it...

742280531.text: Interview? I never saw any such thing on the schedule. Which newspaper?

742280534.text: Ah? Really? Yet what you're holding certainly doesn't look like an otter.

742280535.text: Of course not! This happens to be the one we're looking for this time.

742280536.text: Eh? This blue creature can't be me, can it? Looks nothing like me...

742280537.text: HEY! Watch what you're calling a blue creature. This is none other than the eminent Monsieur Neuvillette!

742280540.text: Mr. Iaune, please refrain from undue alarm. I understand that your heavy workload and lack of sleep might have left you rather tightly wound, but you must remain calm.

742280541.text: As you well know, the world looks profoundly different through Melusine eyes. Thus, it is entirely possible that to them, the Iudex appears... well, like that.

742280542.text: Mmm, pretty much! Monsieur Neuvillette actually looks a bit different to every Melusine, so we split the difference.

742280543.text: Ah, you split the difference? I see, a most judicious approach.

742280544.text: In that case, might I inquire what matter you wish to see Monsieur Neuvillette about?

742280545.text: We're here to give him a g...

742280546.text: ...Gun salute! A 21-gun salute for Monsieur Neuvillette, hehe...

742280547.text: (Phew! That was a close call, we almost told someone else about the secret gift again!)

742280548.text: ...A—A gun salute? Inside the Palais Mermonia? Inside the Iudex's office?

742280549.text: Mr. Roialte, please calm down, you're also becoming unduly alarmed...

742280550.text: Um, err, can you say something? Paimon's getting scared...

742280551.text: Sorry. I'm naturally the silent type.

742280552.text: Please don't make Paimon beg! Stop rubbernecking!

742280555.text: It's not that Paimon can't sympathize, but it looks like Roialte's really about to call the Gardes...

742280556.text: And if he really calls Neuvillette over, then the surprise they worked so hard to prepare will be for nothing, and things'll get waaay more awkward...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Puca and take the Melusines to see Neuvillette

742280801.text: Okay then, please lead the way to Monsieur Neuvillette's office!

subQuests.subQuestName: Take the Melusines to see Neuvillette

742280901.text: Ah, I thought it might be you.

742280902.text: I had heard Melusine voices, and went to the window for a look... Only to find the angle was wrong, and I couldn't see a thing.

742280903.text: ...I trust you encountered no difficulties on your way?

742280904.text: No, not at all! Uh, well, not exactly...

742280905.text: You briefly fill Neuvillette in on what happened...

742280907.text: *ahem* ...Laume, you were indeed the first at fault here. You must secure the consent of others before making requests, and mustn't impede their duties or daily lives.

742280908.text: Extra caution should be exercised with matters such as interviews.

742280910.text: And the "Buoyant Otter Gazette" desperately needs rebranding.

742280912.text: It's nothing! I—I'll go find them both and apologize right now!

742280913.text: Hey, remember to greet them politely first, even when you're apologizing!

742280914.text: (Yes, that should suffice... Lecturing's never been my strong suit...)

742280915.text: Now, back to the matter at hand. How might I help you all today?

742280916.text: Hehe... It's probably best if the Melusines tell you themselves!

742280918.text: (Oh, zounds! We were all so busy making the gift, we never stopped to plan how to actually give it to Monsieur Neuvillette so it feels like a surprise!)

742280919.text: (It'd be perfect if we could actually give a gun salute right about now! KA-BOOM BOOM, it'd be totally... wait, no! No gun salutes allowed in offices, right?)

742280920.text: (If only Laume was here, she's so carefree... Laume, come on, it's our hour of need!)

742280921.text: I'm baack! Those two gentlemen are both great people! They not only didn't scold me, but they even served me tea, too!

742280922.text: Huh? Why haven't you given him the clothes yet? I already finished two whole cups!

742280923.text: (AAH! She just said it like it was nothing!)

742280929.text: The Melusines practically fall over themselves as they cheerfully clamor to explain the "surprise gift" and how it all came about...

742280930.text: Yet for reasons unknown, both givers and recipient remained a touch awkward.

742281001.text: I'm telling you, I saw it in a magazine before...

742281002.text: Uh, you sure? You're not making it up, are you?

742281004.text: Come on out, now. It's me.

742281006.text: Whoa, it's Pahsiv! So, you know Neuvillette?

742281007.text: "Pahsiv"? This is how you address her, then?

742281009.text: That's what she meant!? Oh... And to think that it used to keep Paimon up at night, tossing and turning... Even lost sleep over it...

742281014.text: Puca, allow me to introduce you. This here is the nice vishap... Err, nice vishap lady who helped you before.

742281015.text: Whoa, vishaps can turn into Melusines? That's so cool! Now we can hold hands!

742281016.text: Thank you for saving me. How about I treat you to a nice meal?

742281020.text: I take it you really like Tidalga?

742281021.text: Wait, that means you gave us your favorite food... Wow! Thank you so, so much!

742281024.text: If that's the case, why not picnic here with us?

742281025.text: I'll handle the food! I caused everyone so much trouble back at the Palais Mermonia, it's the least I can do!

742281026.text: Then I'll prep some tidalga for Pahsiv!

742281027.text: Everyone works hard to prepare the delicious meal before enjoying it together.

742281028.text: And though Pahsiv basically ate nothing but tidalga (and polished off every last bite), her delight was plain for all to see.

742281011.text: Good call, he'll think of it as a challenge...

742280201.text: Thanks so much for your help, and stay safe!

742280701.text: Communicating with Melusines always requires a bit more effort. The usual methods simply aren't very effective...

742280702.text: There's something else I've been wondering... Can't seem to wrap my head around it.

742280704.text: Think about it! Melusines are all so kind and clever, and they live practically forever! They're perfectly suited for our line of work, aren't they?

742280706.text: You just listed every reason they'd make disastrous Gestionnaires.

742289901.text: Look over there, it's a Melusine!

742289902.text: Huh? What is she doing? Could she be in trouble? Let's go see!

742289903.text: Locked on: The shiniest, brightest Beryl Conches!

742289904.text: Whoa, any shell that shiny even underwater has gotta be quality!

742289905.text: Nice, shells secured! Not a single hiccup!

742289908.text: Ah! What was that? Puca might really be in trouble, let's go back and check on her!

742289909.text: Where could Roialte and Iaune possibly have gone off too... Eh? What are all these Melusines doing here?

742289910.text: Is today Melusine family visitation day?

742289911.text: Quite the hubbub. Almost as busy as the end-of-quarter reimbursement period.
